title: The Reassign lead technician window shows a Technician change each time it opens
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new staff member for this test, staff member A, on the built-in Parts Manager role, with Time Clock on and Technician on, enrolled at the test location only, leading no work, so switching Technician off shows no warning.
  • Have a new staff member for this test, staff member B, on the built-in Technician role, with Time Clock on and Technician on, enrolled at the test location only, so the list has a technician to compare with.
  • Have a new service work order for this test, work order 1, at the test location, in Approved, led by staff member B.
  • Have Settings, Staff open in a second browser tab.
  • Start on Work Orders, Board View, at the test location.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1's card more-actions menu.
  2. Click Reassign lead technician.
  3. Close the window without picking anyone.
  4. Switch to the Settings, Staff tab.
  5. Open staff member A's Edit Staff Member window.
  6. Switch Technician off.
  7. Click Save & Close.
  8. Switch to the Board View tab.
  9. Open work order 1's card more-actions menu.
  10. Click Reassign lead technician.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The more-actions menu opens.

Step 2:

  • The window offers staff member A.

Step 3:

  • The window closes and the lead is unchanged.

Step 4:

  • The staff list shows.

Step 5:

  • The window shows Technician on.

Step 6:

  • Technician is off.

Step 7:

  • The window closes and staff member A's row shows "No".

Step 8:

  • Board View shows, not reloaded.

Step 9:

  • The more-actions menu opens.

Step 10:

  • The window no longer offers staff member A.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Technician Toggle", Confluence 977371146, version 17 (2 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 2 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11788, story SV-11879 (Story 1, Technician toggle on a staff member), story SV-11881 (Story 3, Who appears on the technician lists)

  • S1-E3: “A screen that is already open when a staff member's Technician toggle is saved keeps its lists until it loads them again; nothing is pushed to open screens. A work order's technician dropdowns show the change once the work order is opened again or the page is reloaded; reopening a dropdown on the same page does not. Board View and Tech View show it when opened from the menu, a link or the display switcher, when the filter or location changes, or on reload; coming back with the browser's Back within 30 seconds shows the board as it was. The Assign / Reassign lead technician window shows it every time it opens.”
  • S3-R4: “The Assign lead technician and Reassign lead technician window (from a card's more-actions menu on Board View or Tech View) offers only people per S3-R1. Searching for anyone else shows the existing No technicians match “[search]” message. A current lead who is not offered per S3-R1 is listed last, cannot be picked, and is labeled "Current · no longer assignable"; searching for their name finds that entry.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.

References from Design

Design canvas "Technician Toggle" (https://claude.ai/artifact/1fuPz8Y4xTg7Syq1mfmJ9R), version 1793629882-06f7, read 2 Nov 2026: page "5 Board View and Tech View", pictures "Reassign lead technician, searching "Oli"" (This build) and "Reassign lead technician, searching "Oli"" (Production today (before))

Design pictures attached to this case:

  • tt-p5-08-after-reassign-lead-technician-searching-oli.png
  • tt-p5-07-before-reassign-lead-technician-searching-oli.png

The design's own words:

  • “No match: "No technicians match "Oli"". Only staff whose Technician toggle is on and whose Time Clock is on are offered.”
  • “Opened from a card's more-actions menu on Board View. Olivia Garrett is offered as a lead.”

The design draws the Reassign lead technician window only; Assign lead technician is not drawn.
